uid.description: Account uid of the space that owns the resource.

path.description: Path segments of the document within the space; empty for the space's root document.

version.description: Specific version to discover; omit to discover any version.

latest.description: When `true`, any discovered version counts as success, not just `version`.

output.description: Current state of the discovery task, with the found version or error.

description: Starts or re-pokes background discovery of a resource that is not available locally and reports whether it is pending, found, or failed; safe to poll.
